about: How sure the model is about each feature, for the map and Overview 'Sure / unsure' overlay (docs/CONFIDENCE.md). scripts/build_confidence.py gives every feature in the shared inventory a default level; entries here override it with a reason, record the owner's decision, or mark a known gap (something visibly there that is not modelled). A level is a judgement for the game, not placement approval (docs/PLACEMENT_VERIFICATION.md).

levels.photographed: Clearly photographed: what it is and how it fits its neighbours is clear in the photos. Sizes and exact map position can still be off by up to about a metre.
levels.estimated: Seen in photos, but only partly (one angle, cropped, distant or behind planting): its shape, size or extent is estimated.
levels.inferred: Not seen directly: built from the aerial, the levels survey or what must be there.
levels.registry: Official land-registry footprint: the outline is reliable, the whole map sits about 1-1.5 m off the laser survey.

decisions.accepted: Good enough for the game; no more work planned.

pool_decks.json:middle-deck.why: Fitted to the pale deck on the aerial (0.24 m pixels), 0.31 m rms on held-out points; no solved camera, and the deck south-south-west of the pool is hidden by a tree canopy on the aerial, so the width there is interpolated.

pool_decks.json:south-deck.why: Fitted to the pale deck on the aerial (0.24 m pixels), 0.21 m rms on held-out points; the web photos show the same even band but have no solved camera.

backdrop.json:photo-trees.why: Direction from the solved IMG_2204-2206 camera (each top pixel); distance only from the tree's usual height (Norfolk pines 24-26 m, palms 11-14 m), so it may be tens of metres off. The models are original, not traced.

backdrop.json:aerial-trees.why: Placed where the aerial shows dark canopy outside the resort; the species are not readable from the aerial and are drawn from the mix in the photos (umbrella pines, broadleaf, palms, eucalyptus beside the west wall). Heights are capped so nothing stands above the skyline in IMG_2204-2206.

gaps.name: North pool · spreading tree leaning over the north-west raised terrace
